title: SseEvent
description: One event of the live queue stream, GET /api/egress/stream on the admin daemon (spa mode, session cookie required). On the wire an event is `event: <name>` and one `data:` line of compact JSON; this schema is that event as an object, {event, data}. Two events exist. `queue` carries the whole queue_snapshot(): the stream sends the current snapshot at once on connect and again whenever it changes, ignoring `generated_at` and each open row's `age_seconds`, which change on every poll. `hb` is the heartbeat, sent every 15 s in place of the silence of an idle stream, with the empty object as its data: it is an event, not a comment, because an EventSource never shows a comment to page script, and the app drops a stream that has gone silent for about two heartbeats (a half-open connection). At most 8 streams are open at once; a ninth, or a connect while the broker is unreachable, gets 503 with an error_response body. There is no error event: when the broker stays unreachable the daemon ends the streams and the app falls back to polling GET /api/egress/queue.

event.$comment: The queue update: the whole snapshot.
The heartbeat: proof the stream is alive, nothing else.

data.$comment: Always {}: `data:` must not be empty, or the browser drops the event without dispatching it.
